## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 26, 2026 - Sep 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mary O Keeffe_, Jun 8, 2026, 1/5: "Was logged out, tried to log back in and got stuck on the "Welcome" page where I need to input my details like name, gender and date of birth. I click "Next" but nothing happens. I cannot sign in to access my training. This is highly dissapointing as I cannot continue with my training and fear it will impact my progress. Will be switching to a different app with less bugs."
            2. _Felicity Rose Sunderland Hall_, Apr 26, 2026, 2/5: "There is a bug on the app. When I enter my birthday in the correct format, it says incorrect format so I cannot sign up and join the plan. Please could you try and fix this as I really want to use this app for my running! I used it years ago and really loved it but fell out of running. Thanks!"
            3. _manu duval_, Sep 11, 2026, 3/5: "l'application à bugé 1 ère fois il y a 2 jours : séance enregistrée non visible. ce matin après + de 30 minutes de fonctionnement correct l'application s'est bloquée. un genre de "cafard à la place du temps puis écran noir en partie base . Présence des touches marche arrêt et pause. Aucune réaction lorsque je les touche... 11 sept 2026 - début séance 06h16."
